description: Bus command the gateway emits when a principal ACTS, carrying the display name it just verified on its token. The Stower persists it as principal:profiled, and only when the name differs from the latest one recorded for that DID — so the log holds one line per name a principal has had, not one per act. A name is a fact ABOUT an identity, never part of the record of an act: no artifact carries it, and readers resolve it from the profiles projection. Emitted for a person and for an agent alike; never for a request that merely reads.

_userId.description: The principal's DID, injected by the /bus/emit gateway from the verified token. Clients do not set this.

name.description: The display name from the issuer's `name` claim, as verified on the token that carried this act. A token with no name produces no command at all — the issuer is where a name is set, and absence is recorded as absence.
